name: @oxy.so/bloom-language-compiler-win32-x64-msvc
description: Bloom's compiler: compiles .bloom modules (Bloom's own language) to typed TypeScript, and optimises @oxy.so/bloom-language chains (hoists static chains, opts view bodies into the React Compiler, checks chains against the language spec). A pre-pass in front of Metro's and Jest's own transformers.
